description: ControlJEPA Lyapunov Tube auxiliary loss for hidden-state trajectories [B,T,D]. It constructs a reference secant across inclusive user and assistant spans, computes normalized transversal energy, and penalizes within-span violations of the discrete-time contraction condition; prompt-gap transitions are skipped. This callable returns only L_Lyap, while Eq. (19) combines it with NTP. Paper §3.1 Eqs. (9)-(11), §3.3 Eqs. (17)-(19); official lyapunov_loss.py:90-102,169-180,197-206 at commit f135c2892d240bd2f1e75decca6ceaf8946024eb.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def trajectories(ctx):
    states = torch.randn((6, 3), generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    spans = torch.tensor([0, 2, 4, 5], dtype=torch.float32).expand(6, 4)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(torch.cat((states, spans), dim=-1))}
dataset = synth.Spec("controljepa-trajectories", generator=trajectories, size=8, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="train")
class TrajectoryModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.network = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=3, out_features=4)
    def forward(self, inputs):
        batch_size, sequence_length = inputs.shape[:2]
        states = inputs[..., :3].reshape(-1, 3)
        hidden_states = self.network(states).reshape(batch_size, sequence_length, -1)
        span_indices = inputs[:, 0, 3:].long()
        return {"hidden_states": hidden_states, "span_indices": span_indices}
trainer = Trainer(TrajectoryModel(), train, recipe="structured-objective", recipe_config={"loss": "controljepa-lyapunov-tube-loss", "loss_kwargs": {"gamma": 0.9, "tau": 0.001}, "bindings": {"logits_or_prediction": {"output": "hidden_states"}, "targets": {"output": "span_indices"}}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train hidden-state trajectories with the Lyapunov Tube loss

name: ControlJEPA Lyapunov Tube Loss

parameters.additional parameters: gamma, tau, use_softplus, eps, norm_mode, and anchor_eps are the only accepted **params; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.anchor_eps: finite nonnegative denominator smoothing for norm_mode='d_t' (default 1e-3); zero uses a clamped displacement norm
parameters.eps: finite positive numerical floor for reference-vector normalization and squared-norm denominators (default 1e-8)
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because targets contain span indices rather than ignored labels
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point hidden states with shape [B, T, D], where B, T, and D are positive
parameters.norm_mode: 'v_geo' uses squared reference-secant norm (paper method); 'd_model' uses D; 'd_t' uses local displacement with anchor_eps (default 'v_geo')
parameters.reduction: 'none' returns [B, T-1] with invalid transitions zero; 'sum' totals valid transitions; 'mean' averages valid transitions (default 'mean')
parameters.targets: integral tensor [B, 4] of inclusive user_start, user_end, assistant_start, assistant_end indices; examples with either span out of range or reversed are skipped
parameters.use_softplus: boolean selecting softplus when true or ReLU when false for contraction violations (default true)
